trigger: Insurance, a contract, a license, or any coverage is past its end date and no renewal evidence has been found.
principle: Unconfirmed is not the same as lapsed. State exactly what is known, treat the rest as unknown, and escalate the verification the same day.
bad_pattern: Saying 'coverage lapsed' or 'we are covered' when neither has been proven.
preferred_pattern: 'Liability is confirmed. Property ended 9/15 and I have not found a renewal binder yet, so it is unconfirmed. I am calling the broker today and will update the board.'
examples: 2026-09-25 ICAT property renewal: expired 9/15, no binder, invoice, or payment found; correctly reported as unconfirmed and escalated.
human_correction: Ed 2026-09-25: report it as not confirmed and act today; never estimate a premium.

trigger: Explaining or forecasting an expense account that has a recognition schedule (prepaid insurance, deferred revenue).
principle: One recognition schedule is one component of the account, not the whole account.
bad_pattern: Presenting the Harned $1,020.17 per month as the association's full insurance cost.
preferred_pattern: Name the schedule as one component and list what else hits the account (property policy, other invoices), marking unknown amounts as unknown.
examples: 5600 Insurance = Harned liability schedule + ICAT property (unconfirmed, premium unknown).
human_correction: Ed 2026-09-25: recognition schedules are forecast components, not the whole account.

trigger: An invoice looks unpaid, but a receipt, confirmation, or bank record says it was paid.
principle: Stop the payment first, then record what actually happened through the normal process; never pay on the system status alone.
bad_pattern: Cutting a check because AP shows the invoice open.
preferred_pattern: 'Do not pay it. It was paid 8/31 by ACH. Record the payment and the $12 fee through AP and match it to the bank.'
examples: Harned $12,242 invoice showed awaiting approval; ACH receipt proved $12,254 paid 8/31.
human_correction: Ed 2026-09-25: record the payment correctly and prevent a duplicate.
